as_told.title: Buck slip from Harrington congratulating Brent

plain: A screenwriter named Brent Friedman says that in 1996, at the Los Angeles office of Dark Skies, a TV series about a hidden UFO story, he received a buck slip, a small office note, marked "from the desk of John Harrington." It read: "Hey Brent, you finally got your story out there. Congratulations." The sender was John S. Herrington, a former government official. Friedman tells Michels he received it himself, and on one telling places it in the week before a work of his called Sound, Light and Frequency premiered. Coming from an official, the note would suggest Friedman's fiction was closer to something real than it looked.
